# Slider

A value picked by dragging along a track, when an exact number is not needed.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A rough value where an exact number is not needed. Not for an exact answer people must type.

- **Use it when:** Volume, brightness, a rough range; pair with a number field when precision matters.
- **Not when:** An exact answer people must type.

Instead:

- [Input](./input.md): An exact number.
- [Radio group](./radio-group.md): A few named choices.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys change the value; Home and End jump to the ends. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It has a name and announces its value. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add slider
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
